title: Course Projects
subtitle: Course projects, labs, and assignments.
reflection:
Although these course projects may look basic and immature today, they still show the care and effort I put into them.
I learned a lot of foundational knowledge through them, and the solid base I built there gives me the confidence to keep working in more complex domains.

parallel-programming-2026.title: Parallel Programming A Assignments
parallel-programming-2026.summary: A BUAA graduate Parallel Programming A repository for experiment problems, code, scripts, and run records.

images.ncuSharedMemory8192: NCU memory analysis for the shared-memory version
images.ncuSharedSource8192: NCU source-level analysis for the shared-memory version
images.ncuSharedWarpState8192: NCU warp state analysis for the shared-memory version
images.ncuNaiveO0Roofline4096: NCU roofline analysis for the naive O0 version
images.ncuNaiveO0PipeUtil4096: NCU pipeline utilization analysis for the naive O0 version
images.ncuNaiveO0Memory8192: NCU memory analysis for the naive O0 version
images.mpiMatrixProcessTimeline: MPI large-scale matrix multiplication process timeline
images.mpiMatrixTimeResult: MPI large-scale matrix multiplication timing result

projectIntro: Uses C, Makefile, Shell, and Python to organize experiment code and helper scripts for reproducible workflows.
Addresses typical parallel programming course problems using classic models such as OpenMP, pthread, and MPI, implements various parallel algorithms, and analyzes their performance.

Implemented naive and shared-memory optimized CUDA matrix multiplication, and used Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute to analyze performance across memory access, warp state, and pipeline utilization, building a clearer understanding of GPU execution.

vr-experiments-2026.title: Virtual Reality Integrated Experiments
vr-experiments-2026.summary: A BUAA graduate course assignment repository for Virtual Reality Integrated Experiments.

projectIntro: Organizes project files and explanatory materials for virtual reality course experiments.

os2023.title: MOS Operating System Labs
os2023.summary: BUAA Operating System labs, divided into six major labs with take-home code completion and in-class implementation exams.

images.shellTimeRefill: Shell program timing with fast refill

projectIntro: Read a large amount of OS code and developed a deeper understanding of how operating systems work.
Kept asking and answering my own questions, leaving behind a large set of lab notes.
Used GXemul to emulate the MIPS R3000 processor, with implementation in C and MIPS assembly.
Includes paged memory, processes, IPC, exceptions, file system, and Shell.
As extra credit, studied page tables, $k0/$k1, and the coprocessor, then implemented full page-table fast refill with about 4x speedup in specific cases.

parallel-architecture-2025.title: Parallel Processing and Architecture Assignment
parallel-architecture-2025.summary: Assignment code and report for BUAA graduate Parallel Processing and Architecture, centered on convolution and performance optimization.

images.ompDataScalePerformance: Effect of data scale on OMP program performance
images.ompThreadCountPerformance: Effect of thread count on OMP program performance
images.ompThreadBindingPerformance: Effect of OMP thread binding on performance
images.numaBindingCpuUsage: CPU usage comparison before and after NUMA binding
images.perfFftOptimizationTable: Performance comparison table before and after Perf-guided FFT optimization
images.luPerfHotspots: Perf hotspots of original LU program with 64 threads
images.luDrcctprofComparison: DrCCTProf analysis comparison before and after LU optimization

projectIntro: Designed OpenMP programs with different bottlenecks, optimized them, and compared performance across thread counts and data scales.
Experimented with compiler optimization, OpenMP thread binding, and NUMA binding.
Used DrCCTProf and Linux Performance Counters to analyze classic parallel algorithms, find bottlenecks, optimize them, and verify results.

road-accident-risk.title: Road Accident Risk Prediction
road-accident-risk.summary: A BUAA graduate Machine Learning assignment for road accident risk prediction, including preprocessing, analysis, modeling, and report materials.

images.numericFeatureTargetCorrelation: Correlation between numeric features and target variable

projectIntro: Used Python for data preprocessing and analysis to guide feature engineering.
Combined key risk factors and created cross features and basic risk features from domain knowledge.
Built a risk prediction model with XGBoost and used Optuna for hyperparameter search.

kernel-analysis-thesis.title: Undergraduate thesis
kernel-analysis-thesis.summary: Research and Implementation of Fine-Grained Performance Analysis Techniques for Intelligent Computing Tasks, my BUAA Software Engineering undergraduate thesis project.

images.researchStatus: Domestic and international research status analysis
images.dataFlow: Fine-grained performance prediction model data flow
images.yolov8ThroughputPrediction: YOLOv8 GPU compute throughput utilization prediction capability

projectIntro: Decomposed model computation graphs, mapped operators to GPU kernels, generated kernel-level computation graphs, and studied operator-to-kernel mapping patterns.
Built feature prediction models for compute and memory-access behavior, verified experimentally for later interference analysis and scheduling.
Developed automated tools to improve performance analysis and modeling efficiency.

rotating-calipers.title: Diameter of a Point Set Algorithm Visualization
rotating-calipers.summary: A BUAA Algorithm Analysis and Design course assignment, using Java to visualize the solution process for the farthest pair of points in a plane.

projectIntro: Allows users to create arbitrary points on a plane, then shows the process of building the convex hull and using rotating calipers to find the farthest pair of points.

oop-iteration-2022.title: School of Software Cloud Platform (Youth Edition)
oop-iteration-2022.summary: A BUAA Object-Oriented Programming (Java) iterative assignment with four requirement rounds, teacher/student clients, and most traditional SCS functions.

projectIntro: Practiced Java object-oriented modeling and code organization through multiple rounds of iterative tasks.
The teacher client supports course and experiment CRUD, plus adding students and teaching assistants.
Students can join courses and submit experiments; teaching assistants can help teachers manage courses.

career-yiyan.title: Career YIYAN Recruitment Website
career-yiyan.summary: A BUAA Software Engineering Comprehensive Practice project covering company recruitment and job seeking, with feeds, private messages, notifications, and LLM-assisted features.

projectIntro: Strictly followed Scrum agile practices, managed the Scrum board through the course-provided platform, and completed two requirement iterations in 11 days.
Participated across Scrum standups, story-point tracking, pair programming, automated checks, and manual code review.
Companies can manage employees, profiles, recruitment positions, and jobs; job seekers can manage resumes and apply.
Users and companies can publish, like, and comment on posts to understand each other better.
Users can send and manage private messages for closer job seeker-HR communication.
Implemented notifications for private messages, likes, and comments.
Used a large model to provide suggestions for improving resumes uploaded by users.

cloud-yiyan.title: Cloud YIYAN Software Engineering Team Collaboration and Management Platform
cloud-yiyan.summary: A BUAA Software Engineering Basic Practice project: a team collaboration Web platform with project management, collaborative docs, chat, prototypes, and notifications.

projectIntro: Strictly followed agile development with daily standups and status reports, managed progress on Alibaba Cloud DevOps, and completed two requirement iterations in 10 days.
Uses projects as the unit for team management, chat, documents, prototype design, and more, allowing users to create, join, and manage projects.
Provides project documents with rich-text and multi-user online collaborative editing; users can mention others in documents or share documents outside the project with desired permissions.
Provides chat and messaging: users can send text, images, files, and more to other users or in created groups, with delivery and read status.
Provides online prototype design for creating and editing Web page prototypes as the baseline for later development.
Implemented a notification system that alerts users when mentioned in documents or when new chat messages arrive.
Compiled development and technical summaries capturing each team member's reflections to preserve and share knowledge for future team development.
personalWork: Served primarily as frontend developer and Scrum Master, delivering frontend and backend code aligned with the project's positioning and design style, and reviewing code from other developers.

yiyan-microservices.title: YIYAN Academic Achievement Sharing Platform
yiyan-microservices.summary: A BUAA Software System Analysis and Design assignment: a high-concurrency academic achievement platform based on Vue, Java, Kubernetes, and Elasticsearch.

projectIntro: Went through the full process from requirements research, requirements modeling, and analysis modeling to architecture research and design, data design, coding, and deployment, producing documentation along the way.
On Kubernetes, created Deployments and other resources tailored to each microservice, used Ingress for load balancing, and delivered a high-availability deployment that supports high concurrency.
Used Elasticsearch for full-text and advanced literature search, combining keywords with operators such as AND, OR, and NOT.
Analyzes and visualizes researchers' research directions, collaborations, and citation relationships.
Provides personalized literature recommendations based on users' reading, download, and favorite history.
Allows readers to discuss literature or cite it in column articles with analysis and introductions.
personalWork: Participated deeply in every stage starting from requirements research, and communicated requirement details multiple times with our virtual users (instructors and teaching assistants).

Served as project architect, frontend developer, and related roles, designed the overall system architecture, and delivered frontend and backend code aligned with the project's positioning and design style.

compiler.title: SysY MIPS Compiler
compiler.summary: A BUAA Compiler Technology assignment: a Java 32-bit MIPS compiler for SysY, covering lexing, parsing, IR generation, target code generation, and error handling.

projectIntro: SysY is a subset of the C language and does not include pointer variables or floating-point numbers.
Controls compiler behavior through configuration options, including optimization and detailed output for each stage.
Supports detailed output with recursive structures and displays real-time symbol tables to make debugging easier.
Uses constant propagation, strength reduction, and pointer constant optimization to improve target-code performance.

learning-living-platform.title: YIYAN Learning and Living Platform
learning-living-platform.summary: A BUAA Software Engineering Basics team project with separated frontend/backend, supporting educational resource sharing and an online learning community.

projectIntro: Used waterfall project management and produced standardized documentation across the full lifecycle from requirements analysis and system design to deployment and maintenance.
Designed a task-oriented frontend with detailed prompts and embedded guidance to deliver the best user experience.
Used JWT Token for authentication and a heartbeat mechanism to detect whether users are online.
Developed a self-designed resource deletion queue algorithm to prevent unreferenced dead resources from accumulating in platform storage.
Deployed frontend, backend, and database in the cloud with nginx for load balancing and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
personalWork: Served as project lead, coordinating progress, assigning tasks, and ensuring on-time delivery.
Served as frontend developer, designing and implementing frontend code aligned with the project's positioning and style, refining details carefully to deliver an excellent user experience.

archive-system.title: Java Archive Management System
archive-system.summary: A BUAA Object-Oriented Programming (Java) assignment: a separated frontend/backend archive management system for libraries or archives.

projectIntro: An assignment from when I was first learning Java, supporting user management, archive upload, download, search, deletion, and related functions.
Implemented the GUI with Java Swing and used FlatLaf to provide different style and theme choices.
Used Git for version management and provided detailed guidance and prompts for users to improve the user experience.
